title: The 5 Largest Islands on Earth, Ranked (Australia Isn't on the List)

scenes.text: The five biggest islands on Earth, ranked. Number one is almost three times bigger than number two.

scenes.label: Baffin Island · 507,000 km²
scenes.text: Number five: Baffin Island in Canada. About five hundred thousand square kilometers, about the size of Spain, and almost nobody lives there.

scenes.label: Madagascar · 592,000 km²
scenes.text: Number four: Madagascar. About five hundred ninety thousand square kilometers, home to lemurs found nowhere else on Earth.

scenes.label: Borneo · 723,000 km²
scenes.text: Number three: Borneo. Over seven hundred thousand square kilometers, shared by three countries, covered in ancient rainforest.

scenes.label: New Guinea · 774,000 km²
scenes.text: Number two: New Guinea. Nearly eight hundred thousand square kilometers, with jungle, glaciers and hundreds of languages.

scenes.label: Greenland · 2.1 million km²
scenes.text: Number one: Greenland. Over two million square kilometers, and an ice sheet that covers most of it.

description:
The five largest islands on Earth, ranked by land area.
Greenland is nearly three times bigger than the next island, New Guinea.
Which island would you want to visit?
first_comment: Did Greenland surprise you? Which record should we rank next?
